title: Intention audit commit plan (v1)
description: Commit plan for MVP (file-scoped). Each file appears in exactly one commit. Commit entries reference leaf-level intentions.

ready.description: True when the plan is complete and ready for execution

diff_base.description: Base ref for the diff (usually HEAD)

diff_hash.description: Normalized hash of the diff the plan was built for

commits.description: List of commits to create. Each file must appear in exactly one commit.

CommitEntry.description: A single intention-scoped commit. Must reference a leaf-level intention (implementation, tests, docs, observability).

intent_id.description: ID of the LEAF intention this commit realizes. Must be kind=implementation, tests, docs, or observability.

intent_path.description: Human-readable path through the intention tree (e.g., 'Goal/Feature/Implementation')

functionality_intent_id.description: ID of the closest functionality ancestor. Must be kind=functionality.

functionality_intent_path.description: Human-readable path to the functionality intention

subject.description: Commit subject line. Use conventional commit format (feat, fix, test, docs, chore, refactor).

body.description: Optional commit body with additional details

intent_confidence.description: Confidence score for the intention mapping (optional)

evidence_tests.description: Test selectors that verify this commit's changes

supporting_docs.description: Doc paths related to this commit

files.description: MVP uses file list (not patch). Each file appears in exactly one commit across the entire plan.

patch.description: Unified diff patch (future: for patch-scoped commits). MVP uses files list instead.
